purpose: The capability run. AIDP-2K measures thirteen of the capabilities in the AIDP register; AIDP-CAP, the capability set, measures the other eleven that enter the AIDP Score, and Decoding, Contract and Traceability in full. Everything below was fixed and pushed to this public repository before AIDP-CAP's seed existed, and the result is reported whatever it is.
release_under_test: Docupath release 5bd21304cc7f8cbb0fb8ac851457a6cdabbd0b97, the reference run's, unchanged, with the reference run's own environment files (restored from their backup), the same models and the same page-reading service, on a dedicated instance. Three settings differ, and only these: a new, empty database; a new folder for stored documents; and the key that reaches the model provider, because the reference run's has expired. The configuration flags are the production service's switches as those environment files hold them, all 58 with the same values, recorded in a file whose SHA-256 is 2faf9a856d4547e16cd8ac7e9b008fa605b7f1ebb7a51f1675cffd32314565ea, which the run records as it runs; their values name customers' accounts and are not published. The reference run fingerprinted a different file holding its flags (c6947904d75b552f07822d009ad064987741487027971f258a1d0cbaded8a041), which was not kept, so the two fingerprints cannot be compared. The API runs as three processes of that one build behind a round-robin proxy, as production runs the API as several replicas, with one worker.

drand.rule: The seed is the text 'aidp-cap-v1:' followed by the randomness of this round of the League of Entropy mainnet chain. The randomness is the SHA-256 of the round's signature, which bench/make-cap.mjs checks.

corpus: corpus-gen/cap/generate.mjs at this commit, run by bench/make-cap.mjs with the seed above and nothing else: the six field-key types, 160 documents of each (960), the composition in corpus-gen/cap/composition.mjs, the generator settings valid account numbers and due dates from terms on. It also draws the customer's supplier list and bank master, the copies sent twice, the files holding several documents, the instructions sample (10 per type) and the contract sample (20 per type). A case document of Anomaly detection carries no hidden value, implied value, contradiction or upside-down page; the earlier documents a case relies on keep theirs, except a page fed upside down and what the case reads from them. The generator writes no manifest if any document cannot be drawn; a draw stopped for the drawing machine's own reasons (a page that does not load in time) is started again with the same seed, and draws the same files.
customer_setup: bench/cap-customer.mjs: the supplier list and the bank master as supporting files, the rules that look the supplier up by VAT number, registration number, exact name or street and write its code to 'Supplier Code', the rules that flag a bank account other than the approved one, and the platform's purchase-order matching switched on with its default tolerances. The contract lane adds the customer's written formats.
lanes: bench/run-cap.mjs at this commit. main: every document in the full lane under the customer's account, phase A, then phase B (the documents that refer to earlier ones and the copies sent twice); then value locations and matching verdicts. split: every file of manifest.bundles to the splitting step. contract: the contract sample in the full lane under the customer's contract. rules: the instructions sample in the text lane, twice with no instruction and once per applicable instruction, the extraction cache bypassed. Each lane under its own new account. Concurrency 8 for main and contract, 2 for split and rules; transport failures retried and re-queued, answers never retried for their content; whatever fails after the last round is scored as a total failure.
scoring: bench/score-cap.mjs at this commit, tested by bench/test-score-cap.mjs: the eighteen measures of specification section 5.8, and the AIDP Score over the thirty-one score-bearing measures (AIDP-2K's thirteen from the reference run's published evidence, AIDP-CAP's eighteen), split into five layers (section 6). The controls for contradictions, for every mark and for Intake are drawn by the rule in score-cap.mjs, from the SHA-256 of the seed, the purpose and the document's id.
statistics: 2,000 bootstrap resamples, seed 'aidp-v1.0-cap-bootstrap': AIDP-2K's documents within type, as the reference run's bootstrap does, and AIDP-CAP's documents, copies and files within their stratum alongside, each drawn one bringing every unit it carries, in every measure; the score recomputed from both on every resample.
pre_registration_checks: Before this registration: the harness and the scorer ran end to end against the release on nine AIDP-2K documents (already run and published) in AIDP-CAP's format. The generator was developed and tested on throwaway seeds, never AIDP-CAP's: full draws of all 960 documents, the plan drawn for 30 further seeds, and two draws of one seed compared file by file. A pilot then ran the release, on a separate instance with its own database, on documents of the throwaway seed 'pilot-seed-6' in every lane (115 documents and one copy in the full lane, 6 files to the splitting step), on 27 October 2026 between 00:17 and 01:36 IST, and an independent reviewer read the scorer and the generator against its evidence. Everything they found, every change made after them and its effect on the pilot's figures are published in aidp-bench/results/aidp-cap-pilot/. The changes corrected the benchmark (its machine's time limits and the release's processes, scoring rules that misjudged correct or incorrect answers, the drawing of controls, and the generator), never a test the release failed: every failure of the release the pilot showed stays in this registered set. test-score-cap.mjs scores a perfect answer one and a failed answer zero on every measure, charging the failed answer as many checks as the perfect one, on a full draw from a throwaway seed. No AIDP-CAP document was shown to the release before its seed existed.
